entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency trading platform associated with the WOO ecosystem, acquired by FusionX Digital in 2025. In September 2026 WOO X acknowledged withdrawal-processing delays affecting some requests; the exchange remains online, but HEI currently treats it as limited pending resolution.
entity.notes: Do not mark dead or insolvent. WOO X's 2026-09-06 statement acknowledges delayed withdrawal processing and says some requests may remain under review or on-chain processing. Independent reporting describes multiple users waiting up to three days and some cancellations, but does not establish a platform-wide withdrawal suspension, loss of funds, or a financial link to BitMart's restructuring. HEI uses limited as the current operational status until the issue is shown resolved or broader evidence changes the classification.

expected.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency trading platform associated with WOO Network. In July 2025 it reported a contained incident in which nine user accounts suffered unauthorized withdrawals totaling about USD 14 million; withdrawals were temporarily paused and the exchange said affected users would be fully covered.
expected.notes: Do not mark dead. The July 2025 incident caused unauthorized withdrawals and a temporary withdrawal pause, but available evidence describes a contained incident, full compensation, and continued trading rather than a terminal shutdown.

events.title: FusionX Digital agreed to acquire and operate WOO X
events.description: WOO announced a strategic partnership under which FusionX Digital would acquire the centralized exchange WOO X and become its new operator, with accounts, assets, trading, and support remaining uninterrupted.
events.notes: The acquisition changed the operator while preserving platform continuity.

events.title: WOO X acknowledged withdrawal-processing delays
events.description: After multiple users reported withdrawals remaining pending or processing for unusually long periods, WOO X said it was reviewing affected cases and system status and that some requests might remain under review or on-chain processing. The statement did not announce a platform-wide withdrawal suspension or identify a security breach or solvency issue.
events.notes: Use service_outage rather than withdrawal_suspended because reviewed evidence establishes delayed processing affecting multiple users but does not establish a platform-wide suspension.

evidence.title: FusionX Digital to become the new operator of WOO X
evidence.notes: First-party announcement of the acquisition and operator transition, explicitly stating that user services would remain uninterrupted.

evidence.title: WOO X official trading platform
evidence.notes: Current official domain confirming continued exchange operation.

evidence.title: Statement regarding recent withdrawal processing feedback
evidence.notes: First-party acknowledgement that WOO X was reviewing withdrawal-processing cases and system status and that some requests could remain under review or on-chain processing. The statement gives no platform-wide suspension notice, security-breach attribution, or insolvency claim.

evidence.title: WOO X Users Report Crypto Withdrawals Stuck for Up to Three Days
evidence.notes: Independent report describes multiple user complaints involving withdrawals pending or processing for up to three days and some canceled attempts, while explicitly noting that the complaints do not establish a platform-wide withdrawal suspension or insolvency.
